$comment: Copy to triggers.json and edit. Keywords match whole words, case-insensitively. The intro is the ONE private reply Meta allows per comment; the link goes out only after the person replies. Placeholders: {username} {keyword} {link}; spintax {a|b|c}. A trigger without its own link / publicReply uses the value in defaults.

defaults.intro: {Hey|Hi} {username}, thanks for commenting {keyword}. Reply to this message with anything and I'll send you the link. Just so you know, this reply is automated.
publicReplies: {Just sent|Sent} it over, check your DMs
It's in your DMs. If you don't see it, check your message requests
